title: Making $1 with AI is harder than you think: week 3 of the challenge (host recap, not Rob's teaching)
summary: Week three of a challenge series where three strangers have 6 weeks and $100 to build an AI product and earn their first dollar. The speakers are the challenge participants (Kate, Davis, Medhaansh) and a narrator; no clearly identifiable Rob Hallam teaching or endorsed principles are in the transcript, so nothing is attributed to him.
